summary: The V4 metadata sync notes for 5 October 2026 have two items. Anoop Johnson brought tight bounds in column stats, with a writeup on representing stats tightness in V4. Amogh Jahagirdar proposed spec changes: consolidating the separate dv_snapshot_id and column_file_snapshot_id into a single modified_snapshot_id, since readers usually need both sets of changes; with that, assigning the snapshot_id of REPLACED entries so change detection works off snapshot_id or modified_snapshot_id equal to the current snapshot; and dropping split_offsets and format_version for column files, keeping format_version only for manifests in manifest_info. No outcomes are recorded.

topics.title: Tight bounds in column stats
topics.summary: Anoop Johnson presented the question of tight bounds in column stats, with a writeup titled 'Iceberg v4 Stats Tightness Representation'. The notes record no discussion or outcome.

topics.title: Consolidating dv_snapshot_id and column_file_snapshot_id
topics.summary: Amogh Jahagirdar raised that the spec currently has separate dv_snapshot_id and column_file_snapshot_id fields, intended to allow a minimal projection during conflict validation or change detection. The benefit is unclear if a reader typically needs both sets of changes anyway, so the question is whether to consolidate them into a single modified_snapshot_id.
open_questions: Could dv_snapshot_id and column_file_snapshot_id be consolidated into a single modified_snapshot_id?

topics.title: Snapshot ID assignment for REPLACED entries
topics.summary: As currently proposed, change detection for REPLACED/MODIFIED pairs works off entries where dv_snapshot_id or column_file_snapshot_id equals the current snapshot ID. With a single modified_snapshot_id, the REPLACED entry's snapshot_id could be set to the previous modified snapshot ID (or the current snapshot ID if not previously modified). Changed entries could then be found where snapshot_id or modified_snapshot_id equals the current snapshot ID.

topics.title: Column files: dropping split_offsets and format_version
topics.summary: The proposed spec change drops split_offsets and format_version for column files. format_version would exist only for manifests and be stored in manifest_info.
